title: Vietnamese Stir Fry with Herbs
description: A flavorful and easy-to-make vegetarian stir fry recipe inspired by Vietnamese cuisine, perfect for a quick dinner.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the sliced onion and bell pepper, and stir-fry until they start to soften.
Add the grated carrots, bamboo shoots, minced garlic, and grated ginger.
Stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes, until the vegetables are tender-crisp.
Add the chopped fresh mint leaves and basil leaves, and stir-fry for 1 minute.
Pour in the stir-fry sauce, and stir-fry for another minute, until the sauce has thickened.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.
Garnish with additional fresh herbs, if desired.
Enjoy your delicious Vietnamese stir fry!
